Repo restructure · 2026-10-01

Fundhub Repo Moves

Every file in the repo, what it is, and where it would go. 6,286 files and 491 folders. Nothing is deleted. Anything unclear goes to archive/.

Waiting for Chris. Nothing has moved yet.

Where the files go

Calls to check

  • apps
    The app moves as one block to apps/platform/.That means src/, api/, netlify/, db/, public/, e2e/, vendor/, assets/ and wireframes/, plus 121 app scripts. They keep their links to each other, so most code does not change. The Chrome extension goes to apps/extension/.
  • safe
    The live database will not re-run old changes.Each change is recorded by its subfolder and file name, like migrations/010_products.sql, with no db/ in front. Moving db/ keeps those names the same.
  • stays
    render-service/ stays where it is.Render.com's build setting points at this folder, and that setting lives outside this repo. Moving the folder would break the black-report service until someone changes that setting on Render.com.
  • archive
    .github/ goes to archive.There is no GitHub, so nothing runs it. Code only mentions it in comments.
  • archive
    1,464 files go to archive/, and none are deleted.These are old dated audits and proof folders, 825 scratch scripts in scripts/tmp*, and 8 old notes from the top folder (HANDOFF, AUDIT-FINDINGS and others). The 90 files nobody could identify are all scratch scripts with tmp in the name. They go to archive too.
  • ops
    Work boards move from docs/workflows/ to ops/workflows/.CLAUDE.md, the Claude and Cursor rules, and the skills are updated to the new paths in the same change.
  • marketing
    Marketing is grouped in one place.ClickFunnels pages go to marketing/landing-pages/. Ad rules, scripts and the registry go to marketing/ads/, with SLO-only ads in marketing/ads/slo/. VSL notes go to marketing/vsl/, and testimonials, avatars, offers and the flywheel each get their own folder. Nothing was found for marketing/posts/, so that folder starts with only a one-line README.
  • docs
    Rules and how-to guides get their own folders.The UI and speed standards, compliance and the brand stylesheet go to docs/rules/. The runbook and staff playbooks go to docs/sops/. Journeys, specs, contracts, finance and diagrams stay in docs/.
  • stays
    Settings files stay at the top.That includes .claude/, .cursor/, package.json, netlify.toml, CLAUDE.md, README.md and TODO.md. The tools only look for them there.
  • note
    Files kept out of git move too, and stay out of git.This covers 2,064 proof files in the *-evidence folders and 395 files that were never committed. Each one moves with its folder.
  • note
    Every test still runs.No test file goes to archive. The test runner will also look in the new folders, so the 2 tests that move to marketing/ keep running. npm run ship works the same as before.
